notes.title: DevLog #4 - Story Continues
notes.notes:
Hello there,

notes.title: DevLog #3 - Ready for Demo
notes.notes:
Hello there again,

I'm Murat, creator and developer of the game.
Last month was tough. But we are hanging there. 
There was a lot of problems that we need to solve. But finally we did.

Latest Updates;
- All foot gear abilities are implemented. Dash, Stomp, Levitate, Range Attacks.
- 3 types of enemies and their AI are added
- I composed some basic Menu and Background music for game. (They are not bad but ok I guess)
- Sounds effects are added (This part is really hard, there was a second I almost decided that I will do them with my mouth)
- Main Menu and In-game Menu is working well.
- Save system is added. There are some imperfections but nothing big.
- Started to build a mini map system. A metroidvanian without a map cannot exist.
- Many many minor bugs are fixed.

Thanks for your support. I will post news more frequently. Stay in touch and don't forget:
Add the game to your wishlists :D

-Murat Karakaş

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Interview with Trickster
notes.notes:
Hi, again gorgeous Dipod lovers!

We are here with our second Devlog!

Today, we want to share what we have in [b]Dipod: The Foot Legacy[/b].
As a unique team, we constantly work on many things to produce the best version of our game. We focus on the things we love and people would love!

Let me more specific; 

In [b]Dipod: The Foot Legacy[/b]; There is a clan named Byron Gordon, and in this clan there is Trickster. Let hear Trickster and his story because he is one of the main characters in our story. 

[i]Hi there, I'm Trickster. To put it simply; I am the cleverest person in this clan hehe! While everyone is working in farms and caves, I produce the genius idea to avoid the work. I spend my time in my thoughts. However, this clever mind causes trouble for some people and divines. It is funny, isn't it? Just because they created me with the perfect mind, I am the one who is punished! Whatever, you will see the details in the game. I won't give you any spoiler at this point. 
I have a granddaughter, named Dipod, and she is freaking angry with me. According to her, this is all my fault. This is a rubbish idea! I just made things easier for them but they just don't care about me you know what I don't care at all! Hehe, all in all, I made history and I rebelled the Gods and Goddesses! I'm so proud of myself. Nobody dares to do that.
Whatever, I talked a lot. I have to go but before I go, I want to make some comments.
I'm proud of my game thanks to me. You will see me more in the game. Stay tuned. [/i]

We will continue to share the interviews of other characters, as well. Don't forget to check next week!

notes.title: DevLog #1 - Hello there!
notes.notes:
Hello there!

This is our first devlog and we are so happy to see you here! 

Every week, we will add new devlogs to let you know more about our game; [b]Dipod: The Foot Legacy[/b].

Firstly, we would like to start with the idea and baby steps of [b]Dipod: The Foot Legacy[/b].

[i]From the mouth of our story writer;[/i]

[i]      As a fan of world literature, I always interested in mythologies and mythological stories. When I first looked at the main idea of the game, Monopods appeared in my mind. They are mythological creatures with the shape of a foot. Then, Dipod is created because of the relatıonshıp with feet. On the other hand, I took Sisyphus and his struggle as an example for Dipod and her struggle against the Gods.
Just like Sisyphus, Dipod challenges with lots of curses and she tries to reach her aim in this painful journey. That is why this story will take you to the middle ages with its magical and mythological atmosphere. [/i]


Dipod is a strong female Medieval hero who tries to change her past and comes face to face with the Gods. In her journey, you will be careful and fast! 

We are so excited to share our game with you! 

We would also like to see you join our story with Dipod. 

Don't forget to wishlist it! :)
